title: A regular local quotient has independent cotangent-space kernel generators
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme], let $I\subseteq\mathfrak m$ be an ideal, and assume that $R/I$ is regular local. Then there is a finite set $s\subseteq\mathfrak m$ such that $I$ is the ideal generated by $s$ and the images of the elements of $s$ are linearly independent in the cotangent vector space $\mathfrak m/\mathfrak m^2$ over the residue field $\kappa=R/\mathfrak m$.

source.place: Algebra, Tag 00NR (lemma-regular-quotient-regular), proof: the choice of independent elements in (I + m^2)/m^2 and its spanning conclusion (lines 25758-25777 in the source read).
